currentParagraphText: “Grandpa used the skill to create Bobo, and that took about a decade,” Dina explained. “Even before Bobo was fully created, he was already half-grown, with Grandpa telling me he began preparations before my birth. If he is to create a bow for you, it will take quite a few years, especially if you convince the Mother Tree to donate a branch. Then there are the Records you want the bow to have, which also affects the process...”
